architecture_goal: Core produces independent typed evidence; KLC composes evidence into knowledge; Runner records execution without defining evidence semantics.

contract.definition: Deterministic KLC composition from declared required and optional typed evidence artifacts into versioned knowledge models.
invariants: Inputs are selected by artifact_kind and schema_version, never by task_id or profile_id.
Required evidence is explicit; missing required evidence produces failure or a declared materialization gap.
Optional evidence enriches results but absence is reflected in coverage.
Unsupported evidence schema versions fail explicitly; no hidden fallback or reinterpretation.
Outputs include coverage, diagnostics, provenance and a deterministic content fingerprint.
KLC-to-KLC materialization dependencies are explicit versioned model inputs and do not create Core analyzer dependencies.
Different evidence source families produce distinct knowledge; no source is silently substituted for another.
Composite knowledge is built only from explicit KLC model dependencies and preserves each source layer.
Published capabilities come from completed materializations, not merely requested tasks.

current_materializations.definition: Materialize a supplied physical-model/v1 artifact into typed table, column, key, relationship and gap structures.
Materialize repository SQL statements, relations, field use, semantic roles and source-to-target evidence.

optional_evidence.purpose: Optional physical-model correspondence and target resolution.

current_materializations.definition: Compose one or more repository SQL knowledge artifacts into a workspace-wide SQL catalog without re-analyzing source code.

required_knowledge_models.purpose: Repository SQL knowledge artifacts to combine. Multiple matching artifacts are preserved.

notes: Repository facts retain repo_id and provenance; duplicate repository IDs are rejected.
The composition does not infer cross-repository lineage or merge ambiguous relation identities.

current_materializations.definition: Materialize typed system interface, scenario, dependency, storage and access-boundary records without Task/Suite routing.
notes: The materialization preserves observed records and does not introduce business interpretation.

current_materializations.definition: Materialize a facts-only reference-data knowledge base from typed declared-value and contextual evidence without classifying NSI ownership or semantics.

required_evidence.purpose: Core-owned facts-only reference-data sections and unresolved gaps.

notes: No reference-data classification is performed; observed alternatives and gaps are preserved.

current_materializations.definition: Materialize factual source-to-storage and storage-to-access persistence paths, writes, reads, field mappings and explicit gaps.
notes: No FDP verdict is assigned; incomplete paths remain explicit records or gaps.

current_materializations.definition: Match repository interaction boundaries into inter-repository and inter-system interaction facts.

optional_evidence.purpose: Optional path from ingress to outbound operation.

required_evidence.purpose: Inbound and outbound protocol boundary observations.

current_materializations.definition: Materialize coverage and diagnostics over repository interaction boundaries.
Build strict and extended connected repository islands from confirmed/probable interaction evidence.
notes: This is a KLC-internal materialization dependency, not a dependency between public Core analyzers.

current_materializations.definition: Materialize field-level contracts over matched system interactions.
Compose repository-local flow facts into a queryable repository value-flow graph.

optional_evidence.purpose: Storage endpoints and persistent field correspondence.

required_evidence.purpose: Atomic value-flow nodes, edges, bindings and gaps.

current_materializations.definition: Compose explicit persistence mappings between the code-declared model and the physical model; do not infer JPA default names or conceptual identity from physical names alone.

required_evidence.purpose: Explicit entity/table, field/column, key and relationship declarations.

required_knowledge_models.purpose: Logical objects and members to map.
Physical tables, columns, keys and relationships to map.

evidence_gaps: Method/property access and composite mapping annotations remain explicit evidence gaps in java-persistence-mapping-evidence/v1.
The physical-model/v1 contract has no dedicated schema/catalog fields; qualifiers are preserved without inferred correspondence.

notes: Only unique exact matches of explicitly declared identifiers create mappings; JPA defaults and name similarity are not used.

current_materializations.definition: Compose observed source-code type, field, relationship and inheritance declarations into a code-declared data model without physical-schema substitution.

required_evidence.purpose: Observed model type, field, relationship and inheritance declarations from source code.

notes: Legacy code_conceptual_model/v2 is not accepted as an input or fallback.

current_materializations.definition: Build an explicit cross-layer view from independently materialized code-declared, physical and mapping knowledge while preserving the origin and semantics of every layer.

optional_knowledge_models.purpose: Observed SQL usage kept distinct from declared constraints.

required_knowledge_models.purpose: Evidence-backed correspondence between logical and physical layers.

evidence_gaps: Persistence inheritance mappings remain an explicit gap where inherited fields cannot be attached to a different physical owner.

notes: Logical objects remain primary; unmatched physical objects are published separately and are never promoted to logical entities.

current_materializations.definition: Materialize observed code-level reads, writes and storage access without reclassifying them as declared model or persistence mapping.

optional_evidence.purpose: Unresolved storage targets and incomplete value bindings.

required_evidence.purpose: Observed reads, writes, storage calls and referenced objects or fields.

principles: Different source families produce different knowledge and are not interchangeable inputs for one model.
Mixed legacy sections are split by evidence semantics rather than copied into one replacement artifact.
Composite effective views depend on independently materialized KLC models and preserve source-layer provenance.
Coverage, diagnostics and provenance belong to every target materialization and are not a standalone substitute knowledge type.

section_routes.reason: The legacy section mixes Java model types, physical-table entities and supporting inferred entities.
Declared code relations, FKs, persistence mappings and observed SQL joins are different facts.
Declared type inheritance and persistence inheritance mapping must remain distinct.
Tables, columns, keys and constraints are physical knowledge.
Cross-layer mappings are a separate evidence-backed knowledge type.
Domains are KLC views over independently materialized layers.
Clusters are derived groupings, not raw Core evidence.
Coverage is calculated per target knowledge type.
Gaps retain the semantics and provenance of the affected knowledge type.
Provenance is required on every KLC model and object.
Observed SQL usage is not declared model knowledge.
Observed storage operations and value flow are separate knowledge.
Operations belong to behavior, access and flow knowledge.
Interfaces are system-boundary knowledge.
Access boundaries are system and interaction knowledge.
Scenarios are behavioral system knowledge.
Scenario context and observed storage use remain separate but linkable.
Data flow is lineage knowledge.
Field flow is lineage knowledge.
Response mappings are lineage knowledge.
Converter and builder mappings are lineage knowledge, not conceptual-model input.
Derivations are lineage knowledge.
Dictionary and value-set semantics belong to reference-data knowledge.
Declared value sets are reference-data knowledge.
Dependencies are system-description knowledge.
Physical evidence detail belongs with the physical model and its provenance.
Inspection requests are diagnostics, not user-selectable knowledge.

next_steps: Keep parked portfolio topology outside the installed runtime until the Islands track resumes.
Use typed artifact and KLC model routing for every new runtime materialization; legacy semantic routing is not supported.
Validate downstream consumers against the consolidated typed runtime before release packaging.
purpose: KLC-owned contracts for deterministic knowledge materialization from typed Core evidence artifacts.

runtime_contract.runner_policy: Runner resolves inputs and records lifecycle; it never selects a materializer implementation function.
